title: EXP-035 — Select Form Positive-State Retention Across One Cancel/Reopen
objective: Using only the inherited live Web Client state, determine whether one already-rendered positive Select Form state survives exactly one ordinary Cancel followed by exactly one ordinary reopen. At preflight, require Select Form to already be open and visibly show exact filter text `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02`, Filter By=Name, Case Sensitive unchecked, Starts With unchecked, and a rendered row whose Name exactly equals `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02`. Do not type, clear, repair, or otherwise establish that state in this experiment. If the prerequisite is present, capture it, perform exactly one ordinary Cancel and exactly one ordinary reopen without any intervening filter/settings change or Form activation, then capture whether the reopened dialog retains the exact text/settings and exact positive-control row. Keep the conclusion limited to rendered Select Form UI retention across this single lifecycle boundary.

in_scope: Read EXP-031, EXP-033-R2, and EXP-034 records and decisive evidence before browser interaction
Inspect the inherited Web Client and Designer context read-only

Require the inherited Select Form dialog to already be open with exact `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02` text, Filter By=Name, Case Sensitive unchecked, Starts With unchecked, and an exact rendered matching row
Capture decisive pre-Cancel rendered/accessibility evidence of that prerequisite state
Perform exactly one ordinary Select Form Cancel
Perform exactly one ordinary reopen of Select Form through the supported rendered Web Client Open control
Inspect the reopened dialog before any text or setting change
Capture exact post-reopen textbox text, Filter By, checkbox states, and rendered rows
Perform at most one final ordinary Cancel after post-reopen evidence capture, with no subsequent reopen
Record recovery accounting separately from planned preflight/post-reopen/final-audit captures
Write only the EXP-035 record and evidence under `evidence/EXP-035/`
out_of_scope: Re-entering, clearing, correcting, or otherwise establishing `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02`
Creating or modifying any Form, component, variable, event, script, binding, validator, or other Mongoose artifact
Testing cache eviction, refresh/requery internals, Ext stores, IDO metadata behavior, or database durability

prohibited_actions: Creating, modifying or deleting any non-FX_ artifact
Starting any other experiment or replay
Modifying production data or disabling security
Do not type, fill, paste, press printable keys, clear, or alter the Select Form filter textbox at any point
Do not change Filter By, Case Sensitive, or Starts With
Do not use JavaScript, browser evaluate/run-code, synthetic DOM mutation, or internal Ext stores
Do not press Enter or OK in Select Form
Do not interact with any result row so as to open or activate a Form
Do not perform more than one tested Cancel/reopen cycle
Do not perform more than one tested reopen
Do not authenticate, reauthenticate, log out, or establish a replacement session
Do not create, modify, delete, Save, Regenerate, close, or reopen any Mongoose Form or component
Do not invoke `Unload All Global Form Objects`
Do not change or Save any User Preference
Do not infer database, cache, serialization, persistence, or server-refresh behavior from the rendered result
Do not modify repository paths outside the EXP-035 record and `evidence/EXP-035/`
If the exact inherited positive prerequisite state is absent or ambiguous, stop blocked rather than reconstructing it

acceptance_checks.description: Preflight evidence proves the inherited Web Client is usable without session-establishment action, Select Form is already open, the inherited Designer context remains untouched, and before any lifecycle action the dialog visibly contains exact textbox text `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02`, Filter By=Name, Case Sensitive unchecked, Starts With unchecked, and a rendered row whose Name exactly equals `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02`. If any prerequisite is absent or ambiguous, the experiment stops blocked without repairing it.

Action evidence proves exactly one ordinary Cancel dismissed the prerequisite Select Form and exactly one ordinary reopen followed, with no typing, textbox clearing, setting change, result-row interaction, Form activation, authentication/session-establishment action, or extra lifecycle retry between them.

Settled post-reopen evidence, captured before any text or setting change, visibly shows the Name-filter textbox still contains exact `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02`, Filter By remains Name, Case Sensitive remains unchecked, Starts With remains unchecked, and a rendered row whose Name exactly equals `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02` is present.

The complete action audit proves no textbox input of any kind, no filter/settings mutation, no Enter/OK, no result-row activation, no Mongoose artifact mutation, no Save/Regenerate, no unload, no preference change, no authentication/session-establishment action, and no extra tested Cancel/reopen occurred.

Recovery accounting distinguishes planned preflight/post-reopen/final-audit captures from extra ambiguity recovery and uses at most one fresh untargeted snapshot plus one corrected visible inspection total; unresolved ambiguity after that produces a blocked result.

Final audit captures the actual post-reopen state without repairing it, performs at most one final ordinary Cancel solely to dismiss Select Form, confirms no subsequent reopen, confirms inherited Web Client/Designer Forms remain untouched, and proves repository writes are confined to the EXP-035 record plus `evidence/EXP-035/`. A passing result is classified only as observed rendered-UI retention across this single Cancel/reopen boundary.

notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261007-225604-DG5Z. Rationale: EXP-034 was blocked by its filter-entry method, not by the lifecycle question itself. Its final evidence nevertheless left a rendered Select Form state with exact text `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02`, Filter By=Name, both checkboxes unchecked, and an exact matching row, while zero tested Cancels/reopens were performed. The smallest independent next step is therefore a lifecycle-only experiment that treats that already-rendered positive state as a prerequisite and performs no filter entry at all. This is a different documented approach rather than a retry or workaround of EXP-034's failed input procedure: if the exact inherited positive state is not still visibly present at preflight, stop blocked without recreating it. This isolates the unresolved Cancel/reopen retention behavior and avoids repeating the prohibited setup path.
